name: AIAI Holdings Corporation
summary: AIAI Holdings Corporation, an enterprise founded in Dallas, Texas in 2024, is dedicated to developing an advanced, AI-powered business ecosystem. Its strategy involves the strategic acquisition and global expansion of various companies. The firm leverages its exclusive artificial intelligence platform to substantially boost the operational efficiency of the entities within its diverse investment portfolio. These holdings span a broad spectrum of industries, including construction, healthcare, defense, infrastructure for blockchain data, digital financial instruments, and public sector operations. The company was previously known as MXLII Corporation, undergoing a name change to AIAI Holdings Corporation in November 2025.
